journeys.name: Discover the plugin in the selected host
Understand and invoke the front door
Refresh research and propose law changes
Upgrade, route, and retire old surfaces
Build and verify a release candidate

canonical_skills.purpose: Concise front door, intent classification, authority disclosure, and route selection.
Fresh setup and existing-repository retrofit through inspect/plan/apply/verify.
Dirty-tree-safe affected checks, verified reuse, and exact execution reporting.
Causal diagnosis, local semantic observability, repair, and deterministic next action.
Durable Goal-mode execution, root orchestration, checkpoints, and honest stops.
Claim-specific strict proof and independent reconciliation.
Evaluation, failure harvesting, research refresh, migration, compatibility, and retirement.
Fresh-user, fresh-agent, maintainer, security, recovery, and proof-falsification journeys.

read_only_agent_roles.name: research-verifier

read_only_agent_roles.name: product-journey-reviewer

read_only_agent_roles.name: claim-falsifier

read_only_agent_roles.name: security-reviewer

read_only_agent_roles.name: orchestration-recovery-reviewer

surfaces.name: Canonical source and contract
surfaces.behavior: One navigable, machine-readable source contract and product inventory.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Consolidate into this contract index, live canonical inventories, and generated projections; archive candidate/history outside active authority.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Independent manifest/reference validation against the live tree and adopted contract digest.
surfaces.claim_guard: A coherent document or source digest does not prove package, install, runtime, or product behavior.

surfaces.name: Standards-compliant plugin manifest
surfaces.behavior: A supported .codex-plugin/plugin.json accurately describes shipped components and product entry behavior.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Rewrite descriptions, remove lane/gate UX, include only supported component fields, and bind version to package inventory.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Schema/path validation plus package inspection; host discovery remains a separate claim.
surfaces.claim_guard: Manifest presence is not installation or discovery proof.

surfaces.name: Repository and personal marketplace wiring
surfaces.behavior: Supported marketplace catalogs point to the intended plugin origin and version.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Add repo-scoped marketplace support and tested personal installation instructions; do not infer host registration from catalog bytes.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Catalog schema/path validation, install-byte reconciliation, and independent new-session host probe.
surfaces.claim_guard: Marketplace catalog visibility is not plugin runtime behavior.

surfaces.name: Canonical skill topology
surfaces.behavior: Eight non-duplicative, progressively disclosed skills with valid metadata and closed routes.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Consolidate 14 skills into the final semantic topology and route or retire legacy names.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Metadata/reachability validation plus new-task representative invocations in supported hosts.
surfaces.claim_guard: A valid SKILL.md file does not prove selection, comprehension, or journey closure.

surfaces.name: Project-scoped custom agents and role contracts
surfaces.behavior: Read-only reconnaissance and review agents are discoverable from supported paths; write workers use explicit run-scoped leases.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Move canonical read-only roles to .codex/agents and generate write-worker instructions per work package; retire static lane agents.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Host agent discovery probe, sandbox/effect verification, collision tests, and root acceptance replay.
surfaces.claim_guard: A TOML file or spawned thread is not proof of correct permissions, ownership, or integration.

surfaces.name: Rust authority and acceleration CLI
surfaces.behavior: A small typed CLI exposes inspect, next, fit, check, diagnose, prove, observe, package, eval, and migrate semantics.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Replace the gate/receipt-heavy public grammar with ten product-semantic groups and explicit effect types; provide temporary routers only where justified.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Parser/property tests, no-write probes, behavior tests, help snapshots, exit-code tests, and representative operator journeys.
surfaces.claim_guard: CLI tests cannot substitute for plugin acquisition, discovery, or usability.

surfaces.name: Deterministic plugin package
surfaces.behavior: A package snapshot includes the intended files in stable order with stable metadata, digest, inventory, and build context.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Build from canonical inventory rather than the internal draft; emit deterministic archive, digest, and provenance envelope.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Independent clean-environment rebuild/compare or an explicitly lower reproducibility ceiling, plus expectation-based provenance verification.
surfaces.claim_guard: Digest equality proves byte identity only, not installation or behavior.

surfaces.name: Installation and installed-byte identity
surfaces.behavior: Supported install paths place exactly the verified package bytes under an explicitly selected scope.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Implement capability-probed install verification and clear repo/personal scope; require authorization for writes outside the repository.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Post-install byte inventory and digest reconciliation in the selected live location.
surfaces.claim_guard: Successful copy or exit code does not prove host discovery.

surfaces.name: Host discovery and new-session visibility
surfaces.behavior: The selected Codex host exposes the intended plugin, skills, and supported agents in a new task/session.
snapshot_evidence: Snapshot explicitly cannot prove app or installed-plugin state.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Add host capability adapters and independent new-session probes; report unsupported surfaces without fabricating state.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Same-version package/install reconciliation plus a host-observed listing and representative task invocation.
surfaces.claim_guard: Source, package, and installed bytes cannot promote discovery.

surfaces.name: First-run front door
surfaces.behavior: A fresh agent can identify the product, choose inspect/fit/work/prove modes, and reach exact next actions without reading the full contract.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Create one harness-ultragoal skill and route specialized skills by state and intent.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Fresh-agent comprehension evaluation and real task completion with bounded context.
surfaces.claim_guard: Documentation readability alone does not prove first-run success.

surfaces.name: Fresh repository fitting
surfaces.behavior: Inspect, plan, apply, and verify a minimal agent-first repository setup with rollback.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Unify under HCT-FIT and repository-fit skill; generated files derive from typed desired state.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Behavioral fixture and live temporary-repository journey, including idempotency and rollback.
surfaces.claim_guard: Generated files or receipts do not prove loaded instructions or working commands.

surfaces.name: Existing repository retrofit
surfaces.behavior: Reconcile an existing repository while preserving user changes, conventions, generated ownership, and runnable workflows.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Use semantic ownership and three-way reconciliation; conflicts become findings, never silent overwrites.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Adversarial repositories with pre-existing instructions, partial setup, local edits, conflicts, symlinks, and rollback.
surfaces.claim_guard: A clean diff or successful template write cannot prove preservation and runtime behavior.

surfaces.name: Routine development loop
surfaces.behavior: Inspect changed semantics, choose a conservative legal check set, execute/reuse transparently, and return actionable findings quickly.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Consolidate impact, cache, test, fixture, and result semantics under routine profile; no artifacts by default.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Dirty/clean trees, uncertainty expansion, cache poisoning, timing, interruption, and strict-comparison tests on representative repository tiers.
surfaces.claim_guard: A fast result without executed/reused-work identity cannot claim correctness or performance.

surfaces.name: Diagnosis, repair, and next action
surfaces.behavior: One findings graph yields causal explanations, safe repair, exact rerun, and one prioritized next action.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Unify current state, findings, repair, diagnose, and next; reject prose-only or duplicate authority.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Injected causal failures, ambiguity, unsupported capability, stale context, and operator comprehension tests.
surfaces.claim_guard: A finding row does not prove cause or repair until reproduction and rerun close the loop.

surfaces.name: Claim-specific strict proof
surfaces.behavior: Strict proof executes the exact validators and independent observations required by one named claim and emits an evidence envelope to an explicit output directory.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Replace universal receipt ceremony and duplicate finalizers with HCT-CLAIMS and claim-specific validators.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Stale, wrong-surface, omitted, contradictory, self-signed, tampered, and reward-hacked evidence corpus.
surfaces.claim_guard: Tests, receipts, generated rows, telemetry, reviewer approval, or signatures cannot substitute for the named behavior.

surfaces.name: Zero-dependency local observability
surfaces.behavior: Structured local events can be queried and correlated without an external backend.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Make a bounded append/query store and semantic catalog authoritative for diagnosis, not for claims.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Roundtrip, corruption, truncation, ordering, duplicate, cardinality, redaction, and causal-query tests.
surfaces.claim_guard: Event existence is observability evidence only.

surfaces.name: Optional observability export
surfaces.behavior: Capability-probed adapters export approved event classes and reconcile a query roundtrip.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Keep export optional; absence lowers only export claims, never routine product behavior.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Consent, redaction, outage, delay, duplicate, wrong-candidate, and backend-query reconciliation.
surfaces.claim_guard: A dashboard, exporter process, or successful POST is not roundtrip or product proof.

surfaces.name: Adaptive Ultra orchestration
surfaces.behavior: Live dependency-closed work packages run with read-only reconnaissance, disjoint write scopes, root integration, and recovery.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Replace lanes with run-scoped work packages and a root-owned scope/claim graph; move historical registries out of active authority.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Conflict, stale worker, blocked worker, drift, interruption, recovery, root acceptance, and no-overlap trials.
surfaces.claim_guard: Parallel threads, lane completion rows, or merged diffs do not prove safe orchestration.

surfaces.name: Behavior evaluation and improvement
surfaces.behavior: Representative tasks and traces are audited, scored, triaged, adversarially reviewed, and promoted only after measured improvement.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Create vendor-neutral HCT-EVAL; keep Promptfoo/OpenAI adapters optional and current; retire score-only promotion.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Broken-task, scoring perturbation, contamination, negative-control, replay, and behavior-inspection tests.
surfaces.claim_guard: A higher score, passing grader, or test row cannot by itself prove product improvement.

surfaces.name: Research and law authority
surfaces.behavior: Current primary sources are classified, mapped to product requirements, challenged, and reviewed for staleness.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Use the final source registry and promotion workflow; archive duplicate cards and generated mappings.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Source availability/currentness checks and trace validation that each adopted external requirement has the required classifications and mappings.
surfaces.claim_guard: Publication authority or recency does not make a recommendation binding without product adoption.

surfaces.name: Migration, compatibility, and retirement
surfaces.behavior: Legacy names and surfaces route predictably during a bounded compatibility window and are removed after successor proof.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Apply the explicit migration map, generated deprecation inventory, compatibility telemetry, and removal gates.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Compatibility route tests, zero-active-reference inventory, generated-surface cleanup, rollback, and representative upgrade journey.
surfaces.claim_guard: Renaming files or deleting references does not prove replacement behavior or safe migration.

surfaces.name: Host durable goal integration
surfaces.behavior: The implementation prompt uses the host /goal mechanism when available and records exposed runtime metadata separately from product state.
snapshot_evidence: Snapshot cannot establish host goal or runtime state.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Use CODEX-ULTRA-GOAL.md; capability-probe Goal mode and lower only the host-goal claim if unavailable.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Host-exposed goal state and runtime metadata captured without prompt inference; product progress remains separately computed.
surfaces.claim_guard: Prompt text, repository receipts, or an objective file cannot prove model, mode, or host goal state.

surfaces.name: Release candidate and publication boundary
surfaces.behavior: A release candidate links adopted source, deterministic package, supported installation/discovery journeys, migration status, proof envelopes, and human publication authority.
snapshot_evidence: Snapshot claim ceiling forbids readiness and release.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Implement release claim graph but stop for unresolved channel, license, signing identity, and publication authorization decisions.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Exact live release profile, independent claim reconciliation, and explicit human release authorization.
surfaces.claim_guard: A built ZIP, signature, CI pass, or version bump is not release authority.

surfaces.name: Integrated completion authority
surfaces.behavior: One root-owned reconciliation confirms every required product journey, tool, migration, proof, and external decision at the same live candidate identity.
snapshot_evidence: Snapshot claim ceiling forbids product completion.
surfaces.implementation_disposition: Use HCT-CLAIMS only after all predecessors; no duplicate final packet or checklist authority.
surfaces.proof_requirement: Fresh live context, dependency-closed claim graph, independent final falsification, and no unresolved completion blocker.
surfaces.claim_guard: No subset, aggregate score, artifact count, test count, receipt set, or root assertion may substitute for integrated product behavior.
